module_responsibilities.summary: LUFFY Owner Interface — one typed, kernel-owned surface for owner controls.
Thin owner-channel adapters: authenticate, parse, map to OwnerRequest, render.
Dashboard adapter: an authenticated session's control click → OwnerRequest.
OpenClaw / WhatsApp owner adapter boundary. Live provider hookup: NOT_CONFIGURED.
Human-readable rendering of an OwnerResult. Wording is not the safety contract.
Telegram adapter: an update → OwnerRequest, an OwnerResult → reply text.
Exact owner decisions, through OwnerService only; never executes a proposal.
Channel-neutral authorization: authenticated channel identity → principal → grants.
Local owner CLI through the kernel Owner Interface (cli channel).
Transport-neutral Owner Interface contract: typed request, typed result.
Local IPC between owner adapters and the kernel's OwnerService.
Evidence/chronology/code lenses over the existing vault and record readers.
Bounded typed owner queries over existing stores. No SQL/path/tool input.
OwnerService — the single executor of owner operations. Kernel process only.
